title: Paper plane with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Paper plane body - main triangle -->
  <polygon points='50,18 82,62 18,62' fill='#A8D8EA' stroke='#6BB5D9' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Left fold / wing shadow -->
  <polygon points='50,18 18,62 42,62' fill='#7EC8E3' stroke='#5BAED6' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Right wing highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,18 82,62 58,62' fill='#C5E8F5' stroke='#8FD0E8' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Center crease -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='62' stroke='#5BAED6' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- Bottom fold flap -->
  <polygon points='18,62 42,62 50,72' fill='#8FD0E8' stroke='#6BB5D9' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <polygon points='82,62 58,62 50,72' fill='#A8D8EA' stroke='#6BB5D9' stroke-width='1' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#2C3E50'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='42.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='4.5' fill='#2C3E50'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='42.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M38,52 Q50,64 62,52' fill='none' stroke='#2C3E50' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='#FFB3BA' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='#FFB3BA' opacity='0.85'/>
  
  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <line x1='10' y1='70' x2='22' y2='64' stroke='#B0E0F0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='8' y1='78' x2='20' y2='73' stroke='#B0E0F0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <line x1='12' y1='86' x2='22' y2='82' stroke='#B0E0F0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
